# Experiment J: residual inventory diagnostics (generated by `exp_inventory.py`)

Champion residuals on 18,324 scored pickups (core mode, eval years 2018-19, 2021-26). Residual = actual − predicted; positive bias = over-projection is NEGATIVE here, so bias is reported the usual way: (predicted − actual) ÷ actual.

## 5. Corrections for collected volume

Not tested: the fixed-rate lag correlation is not negative with an interval below zero in every window, so there is no stable carryover signature to correct.

## 6. Gap elasticity of collected gallons (diagnostic)

u = log(actual ÷ champion prediction) regressed on x = log(days ÷ the customer's as-of median gap). Under the model's assumption (gallons ∝ days) the slope is 0; a slope of β − 1 < 0 means collected gallons grow less than proportionally with the gap: early pickups find more than the rate says, late ones less. That is a statement about WHEN the truck comes (pickups timed to full barrels, capped containers), not about production.

| Window | Pickups | Slope (β − 1) | 95% interval | implied β |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| dev 2021-23 | 5,825 | -0.515 | -0.567 to -0.470 | 0.48 |
| confirm 2024-26 | 8,401 | -0.472 | -0.526 to -0.422 | 0.53 |
| least-inspected 2018-19 | 2,867 | -0.542 | -0.596 to -0.493 | 0.46 |
| all eval years | 17,093 | -0.497 | -0.534 to -0.466 | 0.50 |
